capabilities.purpose: Create actionable engineering work items from validated requirements.
Publish prepared implementation work for review.
Inspect repository structure and implementation context.
Read product/catalog state for an explicitly selected marketplace or authorized shop.
Search a marketplace catalog through a normalized read-only boundary.
Read seller inventory state without mutation.
Read marketplace order state through a PII-minimized normalized contract.
Read current marketplace pricing and offer observations without mutation.
Normalize provider-specific product payloads into a stable commerce product shape.
External audio generation when specialist provider capability is required.
Cloud image generation when speed or provider-specific quality dominates.
Reproducible local image generation and controlled workflows.
Cloud video generation for ads, UGC, B-roll and social assets.
